title: Canonical relative affinization of a qcqs morphism
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Give $\mathcal A=f_*\mathcal O_X$ its natural structure of a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Then the underlying module of $\mathcal A$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. There exist an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism] $\pi:Y=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S(\mathcal A)\to S$ and an algebra isomorphism $a:\mathcal A\xrightarrow{\sim}\pi_*\mathcal O_Y$ with the relative-spectrum chart property [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec], together with a morphism $c:X\to Y$ such that $\pi\circ c=f$. More precisely, for every affine open $U\subseteq S$, set $X_U=f^{-1}(U)$ and $Y_U=\pi^{-1}(U)$. The chart $h_U:Y_U\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal A(U)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] has section map $a_U$. Under $\mathcal A(U)=\Gamma(X_U,\mathcal O_{X_U})$, the restricted morphism $c_U:X_U\to Y_U$ satisfies $h_U\circ c_U=j_{X_U}$, where $j_{X_U}:X_U\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(X_U,\mathcal O_{X_U})$ is the morphism corresponding to the identity ring map under [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme].

source.place: Tag 01LY, lemma-canonical-morphism, full statement and proof; relative-spectrum charts from Tag 01LX, lemma-spec-properties

proof.text: Give A = f_* O_X its natural structure algebra via f.c [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. The already proved source-library instance SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent_unit gives quasi-coherence of the structure module O_X directly, without a separate rank-one tilde comparison. Apply [pqf-lem-pushforward-qcoh] to f and this unit module. Its pushforward is definitionally the underlying module of A, so this proves the first conjunct.

source.place: Tag 01LY, lemma-canonical-morphism, first sentence; Schemes Tag 01LC, lemma-push-forward-quasi-coherent; Tag 01HV, lemma-spec-sheaves, rank one

proof.text: Apply clause (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec] to the quasi-coherent algebra $\mathcal A$. This supplies $\pi:Y=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S(\mathcal A)\to S$, affine, and the algebra isomorphism $a:\mathcal A\xrightarrow{\sim}\pi_*\mathcal O_Y$. For each affine open $U\subseteq S$, write $Y_U=\pi^{-1}U$ and let $h_U:Y_U\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal A(U)$ be the isomorphism corresponding to $a_U$. These are exactly the charts and the section maps required in the statement; the cited clause asserts their existence for every affine $U$.

Let $\alpha=a^{-1}:\pi_*\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$. This is an $\mathcal O_S$-algebra morphism, since $a$ is an algebra isomorphism. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-affine-algebra-local-maps] with target morphism $g=\pi$ and source morphism $f$; only the target is required to be affine. For every affine open $U\subseteq S$ obtain $k_U:X_U=f^{-1}U\to Y$ with $\pi\circ k_U=f\circ\iota_U$. The same cited statement says that $k_U$ and $k_V$ agree on $X_U\times_X X_V$ for arbitrary affine $U,V$, and that the induced section map from $\Gamma(Y_U,\mathcal O_Y)$ to $\Gamma(X_U,\mathcal O_{X_U})$ is $\alpha_U$, under the canonical open-subscheme identifications. No affineness of $X_U$ or of $U\cap V$ is used.

source.place: Tag 01LY, lemma-canonical-morphism, proof: identity algebra map; Tag 01LT, lemma-spec-affine, local inverse construction

proof.text: The inverse images $X_U$ of all affine opens $U$ of $S$ form an open cover of $X$: for $x\in X$ choose an affine neighbourhood of $f(x)$. The overlap agreement just obtained is agreement on $X_U\cap X_V$, viewed as the fibre product of the two open inclusions. By [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing], the $k_U$ glue to a unique $c:X\to Y$. On each $X_U$ one has $(\pi\circ c)|_{X_U}=\pi\circ k_U=f|_{X_U}$. The equality clause of that same gluing statement therefore gives $\pi\circ c=f$.

source.place: Tag 01LY, lemma-canonical-morphism, proof expanded on the affine base cover; Schemes Tag 01JA, section-glueing-schemes

proof.text: Fix an affine open U. The section assertion for the local map k_U, together with i_U ≫ c = k_U from gluing, determines c.appLE over U: cancel the canonical top-section isomorphism to obtain exactly a.inv_U. Mathlib Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_appLE (naturality of the Gamma--Spec adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme]) then rewrites c_U ≫ (Y_U).toSpecΓ as (X_U).toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map a.inv_U. Composing with Spec.map a.hom_U gives Spec.map (a.hom_U ≫ a.inv_U), which is the identity by a.hom_inv_id. This proves the required chart equation for every affine U, with all open-subscheme identifications included.

source.place: Tag 01LY, lemma-canonical-morphism, last assertion and proof; Tag 01LT, lemma-spec-affine, ring-map description; Schemes Tag 01I1, lemma-morphism-into-affine

proof_origin.place: Tag 01LY, lemma-canonical-morphism; the identity-algebra construction is implemented via the existing affine-algebra local-map theorem, open-cover gluing, and naturality of Gamma--Spec on open subschemes. Quasi-coherence of O_X uses the proved source-library unit-module instance.
